## Nex-N2.5-Pro on Hugging Face

**Nex-N2.5-Pro** is the mid-tier model in Nex-AGI's newly announced **Nex-N2.5** agentic model family, revealed around September 8, 2026. As of the latest check, its Hugging Face model card is live with full documentation and benchmarks, but the actual weight files are marked **"coming soon"** — they haven't been uploaded yet.[1][2]

### What it is

Nex-N2.5-Pro is built on a **397B-parameter architecture** (17B active parameters, mixture-of-experts) post-trained from a Qwen3.5 base, continuing the multimodal foundation of the earlier Nex-N2 generation. It's designed for long-horizon agentic tasks — meaning it doesn't just answer questions but can plan, act, observe results, and self-correct across many steps. Key capabilities emphasized by Nex-AGI include:[2][1]

- Computer use and browser automation (clicking, navigating, filling forms, verifying outcomes visually)
- Autonomous code execution and testing
- Visually grounded agentic reasoning, where vision serves as feedback rather than just input

### Benchmark performance

Nex-N2.5-Pro sits between Nex-N2.5-mini and Nex-N2.5-Max, and is compared against models like Claude Opus 5, GPT-5.6 Sol, Kimi-K3, GLM-5.3, DeepSeek-V4-Pro, and Qwen3.8-Max:[1]

| Benchmark | Nex-N2.5-Pro | Best competitor |
|---|---|---|
| Terminal-Bench 2.1 | 82.7 | 89.1 (Claude Opus 5) |
| SWE-Bench Pro | 61.2 | 79.2 (Claude Opus 5) |
| OSWorld-Verified | 82.2 | 86.1 (Qwen3.8-Max) |
| OSWorld-2 | 56.4 | 68.3 (Claude Opus 5) |
| OSWorld-G (grounding) | 87.4 | 87.4 (best, tied) |
| BrowseComp | 89.7 | 92.6 (Nex-N2.5-Max) |

It trails frontier closed models like Claude Opus 5 and GPT-5.6 Sol on most heavy coding/agentic benchmarks but performs competitively on visual grounding tasks (OSWorld-G).[1]

### Deployment and availability status

Nex-AGI has published full deployment instructions expecting **single-node 8×H100** GPU serving via a customized SGLang fork (`nexagi/sglang:v0.5.18-nex-patch`), with recommended sampling settings (temperature 0.7, top_p 0.95, top_k 40) and configurable "thinking modes" (none/medium/high reasoning effort). However, independent reporting from September 8, 2026 confirms the **model card is live but weights are not yet downloadable** — unlike Nex-N2.5-mini, which can run on a 2×H100 setup already.[2][1]

This mirrors the pattern from Nex-AGI's earlier Nex-N2-Pro release (June 2026), a 397B Apache 2.0-licensed model that gained attention for rivaling GPT-5.5-class performance on coding tasks. If you want, I can watch for when the actual Nex-N2.5-Pro weight shards get uploaded to Hugging Face.[3]
